agent_roles.audit_coordinator: Applies the sandbox-only audit instruction and owns the case disposition.
agent_roles.risk_router: Selects checks from observable case signals without using the gold label.
agent_roles.check_specialist: Runs one deterministic, inspectable risk check.
agent_roles.finding_verifier: Replays a failed check and accepts only independently reproduced findings.
agent_roles.review_gate: Prevents consequential action and requests a human decision for critical findings.
agent_roles.reporter: Writes the final pass or human-review disposition and supporting evidence.
